about_the_game:
📦 DLC: Lei Feng's Legacy
Take control not only of the government—but of the lives of ordinary Chinese citizens. Follow their personal, family, and professional stories as they evolve under your political decisions. Some of them may rise to the highest ranks of power—and it’s you who decides who gets the chance to change history.

🧬 A New Lei Feng — A New Face of the Nation

"History is not made by leaders alone."
In this compact DLC for China: Mao’s Legacy, you gain access to a simulation of everyday citizens’ lives. For the first time in the game, you can create your own unique citizens, each with their own fate, family, career path, and political stance.

How will their lives change under repression, reform, or chaos? You'll witness it firsthand—and may even elevate the most promising individuals into future leaders, forming a new elite, loyal allies... or dangerous rivals.

✨ Key DLC Features:

🔹 Citizen Generation and Development

  • Each citizen is assigned a social background, character traits, education level, and career

  • Personal stories impact their behavior and fate based on your decisions

🔹 Social Mobility and Class Dynamics

  • Citizens can move up the career ladder

  • Some may gain the opportunity to enter politics—with or without your support

  • Economic reforms, cultural campaigns, repression, and conflict influence loyalty, fear, protest potential, and career growth

  • Recruit particularly promising individuals into the government

🔹 New Statistic: Citizen Impact

  • Measure how your policies affect not just the state, but the people

  • Access the detailed status of every citizen you're monitoring

Lei Feng's Legacy is a step toward building a deeper strategy game—where it's not just about flags, ministers, and resources, but also about the people you lead into the future.
